rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for referring to the indicated item or thing.

example.english: This is the one I want.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 go3

rows.note: Use this when you want to make explicit that the indicated referent is a thing or item.

example.english: This thing is really quite convenient.
example.jyutping: ni1 joeng6 je5 zan1 hai6 gei2 fong1 bin6 gaa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for something nearby, just mentioned, or about to be specified.

example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 gei2 hou2 tai2 wo3

rows.note: Use this for the current or next time period, as in 今朝 for “this morning” or 今次 for “this time.”

example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when first introducing an unspecified person or thing as “this particular one.”

example.english: This particular customer wants to see you.
example.jyutping: jau5 go3 haak3 jan4 soeng2 wan2 nei5

rows.note: Use this self-referential phrase when playfully or emphatically referring to yourself as “this guy.”

example.english: This guy always says the wrong thing when he gets nervous.
example.traditional: 我呢個人一緊張就會講錯嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nei1 go3 jan4 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 wui5 gong2 co3 je5
